variable.description: Testing base URL — provided directly, not read from config.py (this Lambda has no knowledge of its own API Gateway invoke URL).

request.description: Returns a summarized line list plus aggregated totals for every pay-as-guest cart item currently awaiting payment for guest_id.

Records a Razorpay payment for a guest. When guest_id and payment_transaction_id are both present, every pay-as-guest item this guest_id currently has awaiting payment is marked paid and stamped with payment_transaction_id.
